create_BestStateDictManager: create a BestStateDictManager instance to track best model states on cpu or gpu
register_BestStateDictManager: register a StateDictSource with the BestStateDictManager to track its best state
update_BestStateDictManager: update the best state for a registered source in BestStateDictManager
state_dict_BestStateDictManager: retrieve the full state dict of all registered best states from BestStateDictManager
load_state_dict_BestStateDictManager: load a previously saved state dict back into BestStateDictManager to restore best states
